Kai (eng-sre): quick q — where's the canonical saved search for filtering logs by org+model+route+region for 5xx/503 spikes? I need it for an async triage I'm doing.
Maria (devex): we don't have a single canonical one today, we have a couple of org-specific presets. i can drop a concise, reusable query you can save as a preset.
Maria (devex): suggested query (Logsearch):
```
org_id:1234 AND model.name:"acme-gen" AND route:/v2/generate AND region:eu-west-1 AND (http.status:[500 TO 599] OR error:true)
| sort by @timestamp desc
| limit 200
```
Maria (devex): notes: replace org_id and model.name with variables. the route filter supports regex (e.g., route:/v[0-9]+/generate).
Devon (platform): i'd add a token_count filter if you're debugging perf-related 5xx (e.g., tokens.generated>1000) — often helpful to separate long-sequence OOMs vs infra errors.
Kai (eng-sre): nice. can we also include KV-cache hits/miss tags? our logs have `cache.hit:true` and `cache.hit:false`.
Maria (devex): yep — appended version with cache + latency buckets: 
```
org_id:1234 AND model.name:"acme-gen" AND route:/v2/generate AND region:eu-west-1 
AND (http.status:[500 TO 599] OR error:true) 
AND (cache.hit:false OR cache.miss:true) 
AND latency_ms:[200 TO *] 
| sort by latency_ms desc
| limit 250
```
Kai (eng-sre): perfect. i've saved that locally as `ops/eu-gen-5xx-cache-latency`. can someone make it a team preset under "eng-sre > saved-presets"?
Devon (platform): will do — what description do you want? short + the org variable mention.
Kai (eng-sre): "Search for 5xx/errors for gen model routes in EU (replace org_id/model as needed). Includes cache and latency filters."
Devon (platform): copying that. creating preset now and adding to the eng-sre shared folder + linking to our runbook.
obs-bot: Saved search `eng-sre/ops-eu-gen-5xx-cache-latency` created by Devon for channel #eng-sre. Link: https://logs.internal/saved/eng-sre/ops-eu-gen-5xx-cache-latency
Maria (devex): thanks! Also leaving a quick tip: if you want alerts, create a metric alert on `count(http.status>=500)` grouped by route+model with a 5m window; then attach the saved search as the alert notification link.
Kai (eng-sre): great — i'll wire that into the incident play. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
Devon (platform): FYI i'll add a small note in the alert config to fallback to a cheaper model variant route when capacity is low to reduce unnecessary noise.
Kai (eng-sre): sounds good. closing this thread once alert is in place, will ping here with the playbook link.
Maria (devex): ack."
